notes.title: May 2022 Balance Update
notes.content:
With this update, we are buffing a large number of underused cards (list below)

Prisoner's Mana Magnet space is being restricted - Prisoner will no longer be able to use this space to chain Mana Magnets turn after turn. At the end of a turn, if Mana Magnet was triggered on this space, it will now require a full turn to recharge. This change means Prisoner players will have to make more impactful decisions, rather than falling back on a game plan of chaining Magnets after gaining a lead. This restriction should pave the way for buffs to Prisoner's cards

Strime, The Brewmaster has been removed and replaced by Cymon, Head of Security. The new card keeps the same ability, but his stats have been set to 4/5.

Fixed a bug with Lydia, where she would sometimes summon two Corpses instead of one!

notes.title: Markets and Masquerades: Major Update
notes.content:
Into the darkest corners of Old Earth’s underbelly, even the Proctors dare not venture. Here, all manner of creatures lurk in the shadows. Illegal goods and terrible secrets are bought and sold. What is it that you desire? Cybernetic augmentations that will let you crush a tank with your bare hands? A fallen alchemist’s brew that can suspend you in a permanent state of rapture? A friendly duel with one of Earth’s few remaining vampires? Whatever you’re looking for, you’re sure to find it…

The Markets and Masquerades update includes:

-18 brand-new cards
-30 rebalanced cards
-auction system
-new ranking system
-playmats which can be purchased with in-game currency
-quality of life improvements and bug fixes

notes.title: Winter Holidays 2021 patch!
notes.content:
We’re bringing you many changes this holiday season! Bug fixes, QOL improvements, and most importantly, a new batch of cards!

Added:
-15 new cards, including 2 new cards created by our player sponsors!
-New end match animation and screen
-Sound effects for pack opening screen 
-Improvements to our reconnection system — Steam players should now be able to resume a match in progress without restarting the client!

Balance changes:
-Too many to list here! For a full list, please visit our Discord server. 

Bug Fixes:
-Many issues with player-created cards in Draft mode have been fixed
-Blightspear Imp is now functioning correctly 

Events:
-Lirja Raid has now officially concluded! Get ready to face Rudgar in Raid mode for lots of holiday-themed fun! 

Thank you to everyone who continues to help us make Fatal Core the best purchase-free indie TCG!
